verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes 150 backlinks as a concrete campaign-delivery acceptance condition; the administrative trial price and duration are not included as attributes.
The client unambiguously accepts the proposed mixed backlink profile of 60% dofollow and 40% nofollow; no prior attribute becomes obsolete.

This is the first concrete verification that 183 backlinks were delivered across 135 domains, satisfying the campaign's link-count acceptance condition without asserting verification of the follow-type ratio.
